title: Profile
text: Jackson Lawrence is a creative technologist: an AI engineer and designer. He is based in Kota Tangerang, Banten, Indonesia. Languages: Indonesian and Hokkien (native), English (full professional), Chinese (limited working), Korean and Japanese (elementary).

title: Education
text: Jackson graduated in Computer Science from Universitas Multimedia Nusantara (UMN), Aug 2022 to Aug 2026, with a 4.00 CGPA in all 8 semesters on a full merit-based scholarship. He is studying an MBA in Project Management at GBS Malta, Oct 2026 to Oct 2027. He won math olympiad medals from 2017 to 2019 (HKIMO, TIMO, SEAMO, AIMO) and holds IT Specialist (Artificial Intelligence) and Huawei HCIA-AI V3.5 certificates.

title: Thesis
text: Jackson's thesis is on multilingual NLP: identifying hate speech spans in Indonesian-English code-mixed text with multi-task learning on BLOOM-560M.

title: Lab assistant
text: Jackson was a lab assistant for four courses at UMN, teaching 200+ students with satisfaction scores from 93.71 to 98.85 out of 100: Object Oriented Programming (Java, 80 students), Database Systems (SQL, 40), Algorithms and Data Structures (C, 40) and IF 110 (40).

title: AI.DECE internship
text: Jackson was an AI Engineer Intern at AI.DECE from Feb 2025 to Feb 2026. He worked with LLMs, RAG, LangChain, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Next.js and Docker on document processing, semantic search, automated reporting and data visualization.

title: Other engineering work
text: Jackson was an R&D Intern at PT Quantum Infra Solusindo from Feb to Apr 2025, working on an asynchronous message queue with RabbitMQ and a real-time monitoring dashboard in Next.js for hospital-oriented systems. He was also a web developer for UMN ECO 2024 and Infinite UMN 2024 (React + Laravel) and PIC of PPIF 2024.

title: Design and marketing
text: From Nov 2024 to Feb 2026 Jackson was a Digital Marketing Consultant at Bangsar Heights Pavilion Sdn Bhd (Kuala Lumpur, remote): social media, Instagram and Facebook ads, brochures, banners, flyers, booth design, photography, video and visual branding for property marketing across Indonesia and Malaysia. The campaigns passed 200,000 views and were used by the sales team.

title: Toolkit and roles
text: Jackson's toolkit has 19 tools across 5 disciplines: Python, JavaScript, Laravel, React, Next.js, LangChain, ChromaDB, Weaviate, OpenAI API, MySQL, Docker, RabbitMQ, Photoshop, Lightroom, Figma, Spline 3D, Blender 3D, Premiere Pro, After Effects.
